# SQLite API header

`sqlite3.h` is the SQLite 3.54.1 amalgamation header from
https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip (archive SHA3-256
`92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30`).
SQLite is public-domain software; see https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html.
Windows dynamically loads the operating system `winsqlite3.dll`; no SQLite
library is bundled. Linux links its distribution's SQLite library.
